name: Heart of Gaia
storyline:
Four centuries ago, the world witnessed the Decline of the Gods — the end of an age where divine forces walked among mortals. At the heart of this cataclysm a creature forged in the depths of primordial Chaos: Draltaksan, an ancient dragon born from absolute darkness.

Forged at the dawn of the world, Draltaksan belongs to the oldest of the three tyrant races: the dragons — beings born of Chaos, in contrast to humans, shaped between light and shadow, and elves, born from pure light. His rise marked the collapse of harmony among peoples and the fall of the deities that once protected the balance of the world.

Through an unprecedented sacrifice, the threat was contained — but never destroyed.

Now, in a new era of apparent prosperity, the world begins to crack once more. Forgotten signs return. Whispers echo through ancient ruins. Silent cults invoke names long erased from the memory of mankind.

Amid this rising tide of darkness, a young man marked by the past is summoned to the royal capital of Aetheria. His calling is not merely the beginning of a journey, but the rise of a fragile hope in the face of the first shadows threatening to descend upon the world.
summary: Lead the resistance against an ancient, dark order seeking to awaken an ancient evil and plunge Gaia into chaos. Explore a vast, Steampunk-themed fantasy world and face formidable adversaries in this action RPG featuring real-time character switching and dynamic combat.
